items.title: French MPs approve assisted dying law with strict rules after years of argument
items.description: The bill would allow assisted dying for terminally ill adults who meet strict criteria.

items.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran as Trump warns Tehran it 'better behave'
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he is yet to decide whether or not he will "finish off" Iran.

items.title: Trump retreat over Hormuz tolls suggests he is struggling to end Iran war
items.description: The abrupt about-face from the US president was the latest twist in a conflict that has now lasted more than four months.

items.title: More people around the world now favour China over the US, Pew study suggests
items.description: There is more confidence in Xi Jinping than Donald Trump, the US think tank's survey indicates.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 14 as Ukraine hits Black Sea oil tankers
items.description: Civilian casualties are reported in a number of Ukrainian regions, while Kyiv hits 20 Russian vessels in the Black Sea.

items.title: Special police team to investigate killing of an anti-migrant leader in South Africa
items.description: The March and March provincial leader died of his injuries in hospital several days after being shot.

items.title: Five arrested after Hong Kong police raid independent bookshops
items.description: Officials say they are suspected of selling "seditious" books which incited "hatred" against authorities.

items.title: Italy's Meloni suffers surprise setback in close vote on electoral reform
items.description: The defeat triggered opposition calls for Meloni to resign ahead of next year's general election.

items.title: Rastafarians in Kenya fail in bid to get cannabis legalised for religious purposes
items.description: The court acknowledged the need for a broader national debate on cannabis policy in Kenya.

items.title: Venezuela government to launch formal talks with opposition members
items.description: The opposition says the aim of the talks is to strengthen the democratic institutions and the electoral system.

items.title: China economic growth falls sharply, missing target
items.description: Weak demand domestically and the impact of the Iran war on oil prices overshadowed the country's strong exports.

items.title: Heatwave prompts Italy's delivery riders to strike for extra rights
items.description: Delivery riders in Milan, Bologna and Florence want to protect their health and their wages.
